entities.summary: Herbert Birchby Warburton was an American lawyer and politician from Wilmington, in New Castle County, Delaware, and Frankford, in Sussex County, Delaware. He was a veteran of World War II, and a member of the Republican Party, and served as U.S. Representative from Delaware.
